dialog: You're gonna get hurt if you look down on me!
I'm not just gonna float here and take this!
I'll fight if it's to help everyone out!
I should be able to do this!
You're really getting on my nerves/ you know!
I never fight thinking what will happen if I lose!
I won't let you have your way. Time to push back!
Ultra Special... Golden Delicious... Giant Magnum...!
Hyper Gold... Luxury Full Automatic... True Final Virtual Romancing...
Huh? What was I just doing/ again?
Urp/ I lost sight of them...
H-Huh? Where did that just come from...?
Hey/ there's a bad guy over there!
It's decided! Now let's get a move on!
Whoops! Should I stay where I am?
What do you need me to do?
I'll do the best I can!
How dare you do that to Lady Kanako!
I'll do as you tell me/ Lady Kanako!
Lady Kanako/ there's a bad guy over there!
What should I do/ Lady Kanako?
I'll give them a real shock/ Lady Kanako!
How dare you do that to Lady Suwako!
I'll do as you tell me/ Lady Suwako!
Lady Suwako/ there's a bad guy over there!
What should I do/ Lady Suwako?
I'll give them a real shock/ Lady Suwako!
How dare you do that to Orin! I won't forgive you!
Move it/ Orin! Out of the way!
Orin/ there's a bad guy over there!
I'll give them a real shock/ Orin!
How dare you do that to Miss Satori!
I'll do as you tell me/ Miss Satori!
Miss Satori/ there's a bad guy over there!
What should I do/ Miss Satori?
I'll give them a real shock/ Miss Satori!
How dare you do that to Miss Koishi!
I'll do as you tell me/ Miss Koishi!
Miss Koishi/ there's a bad guy over there!
What should I do/ Miss Koishi?
I'll give them a real shock/ Miss Koishi!
Ugh/ I don't want to be here for this!
That doesn't even count as getting hurt!
I'm not done yet! I'm gonna keep pressing forwards!
That was nothing compared to the fires in Blazing Hell!
Like I'd ever give up from this!
Is this all the power I have?!
Well/ I've got more enthusiasm than you!
Yikes/ I've gotta take a second to calm down...
I'll be up and at 'em in no time!
It's gonna take more than that!
I may not be able to follow your movements/ but you're not gonna surprise me!
Oh/ you're in for it now!
That was a really dumb attack! You'll never hit me with that!
You won't catch me like that!
I'm not letting you near me that easily!
But I did my very best...
They got me... Maybe I really am nothing without Lord Yatagarasu...
You'd better believe I'll get my revenge next time!
I can't believe I've gotta drop out during the important part... The rest is up to you!
I'm not gonna lose to the likes of you!
I'm not scared! I mean it. I'm not!
Check out my danmaku/ Miss Koishi!
I've been looking for you for forever/ Miss Koishi!
You're trying to do something bad again/ aren't you?!
Unyu! She made fakes of everyone!
I can't even tell the difference...
You're super strong/ but you shouldn't be using your strength that way!
Yeah/ well/ I bet I'm cleaner than you!
You're not getting away with anymore evil!
You're supposed to say sorry if you do something bad!
You shouldn't use your power like that!
What? There's nothing I can do?
You're super strong too/ but you won't beat me!
I don't care if you've got the power of dreams on your side! I'll force it back!
It doesn't matter whether I have Lord Yatagarasu's power or not!
You're super strong too/ but you won't beat me!
I don't care if you've got the power of dreams on your side! I'll force it back!
It doesn't matter whether I have Lord Yatagarasu's power or not!
Leave the rest to me/ Mehko!
You can leave the rest to me/ Makura!
I've got it/ Makura! You seem pretty frail.
